{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Event Handlers

|descr= Removes scripted event handler with given name and id.
Additionally "ScriptedEventHandlerRemoved" scripted EH is called.
{{Feature|informative|For a list of available scripted event handlers, see [[Arma 3: Scripted Event Handlers]].}}

|s1= [namespace, name, id] call [[BIS_fnc_removeScriptedEventHandler]]

|p1= namespace: [[Namespace]], [[Object]], [[Group]], [[Location]], [[Boolean]], [[Control]] or [[Display]] - namespace in which handler is saved

|p2= name: [[String]] - handler name

|p3= id: [[Number]] - EH id

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] if removed, [[false]] if didn't exist

|x1= <sqf>[missionNamespace, "event", 2] call BIS_fnc_removeScriptedEventHandler;</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_callScriptedEventHandler]] [[BIS_fnc_addScriptedEventHandler]] [[BIS_fnc_removeAllScriptedEventHandlers]]
}}
